title: Since Update 2.8.1.1 history is empty
body:

I think I found another related issue. If you add the carbs from nightscout they are not downloaded into the AAPS treatments. 
 Seems related. AAPS 2.8.0 working but 2.8.2 and 2.81.1 stopped importing/downloading information from nightscout

@radu-neacsu No, what you describe is not a bug but a feature :)
There is an bug in NS that caused errors in AAPS (too much insulin delivery) when data was D/Led from NS to AAPS. For security reasons, until the NS bug is resolved, AAPS will only UPLOAD to NS , D/L is turned off.
@radu-neacsu You can turn D/L from NS _ON_ if you put engineering mode but you should be well aware of the risks and the way they may or may not affect you.
using engineering mode is the only way currently to switch NS_UPLOAD_ONLY to false.
PLEASE OPEN A NEW ISSUE THID HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH THE MENTIONED PROBLEMS! THANK YOU
